samples.xml_description:
<module id="accu">
    <description>Serial input data accumulation output, input is 8bit data. Accumulates 4 input data and outputs the sum with valid_out indication.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock input for synchronization.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="data_in" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input data for addition.</input>
        <input id="valid_in">Input signal indicating readiness for new data.</input>
        <output id="valid_out">Output signal indicating when 4 input data accumulation is reached.</output>
        <output id="data_out" width_description="[9:0]">10-bit output data representing the accumulated sum.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="ACCUMULATION_COUNT">4</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="count">Count of valid input data received.</reg>
        <reg id="accumulated_sum">Accumulated sum of input data.</reg>
        <wire id="new_data_valid">Indicates if new data is valid.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                count <= 0;
                accumulated_sum <= 0;
                valid_out <= 0;
            end else begin
                if (valid_in && !new_data_valid) begin
                    accumulated_sum <= accumulated_sum + data_in;
                    count <= count + 1;
                end
                if (count == ACCUMULATION_COUNT) begin
                    valid_out <= 1;
                    new_data_valid <= 1;
                end else begin
                    valid_out <= 0;
                    new_data_valid <= 0;
                end
                if (new_data_valid) begin
                    count <= 0;
                    accumulated_sum <= 0;
                end
            end
        end
        data_out <= {accumulated_sum, count};
    </implementation>
</module>
